author: New China TV
description:
Spring migration has reached its peak at Hengshui Lake in north China's Hebei Province, where tens of thousands of migratory birds are stopping to rest, refuel, and breed. 
As a national nature reserve preserving a complete wetland ecosystem on the North China Plain, and a key stop along the East Asia-Australasia Flyway, the lake has recorded 337 bird species, with peak populations exceeding 100,000.
title: Spring migration peaks at north China's Hengshui Lake

author: New China TV
description: For over 90 years, a family in a remote village in China's Jiangxi has guarded the grave of Red Army commander Deng Yigang. Every Qingming Festival, generations of the Xie family still tend to his tomb -- honoring a martyr who died of battle wounds in 1932, and a spirit that transcends time.
title: A village family's decades-long watch over grave of Red Army martyr
